        value=str(value)
    return value.casefold().strip()

def source_unique(values):

    for value in values:

            return
    out.append({'term':term,'support_ids':support})

def source_has(term,name):

    while todo:
        item=todo.pop()
        if isinstance(item,list) and item:
            if item[0]==name:
                return True
            i=1

    return False

def source_find_after(spans,index,phrases,limit):
    stop=min(len(spans),index+limit+1)

    while i<stop:
        text=source_low(spans[i].get('text',''))

                return i
        i+=1
    return -1
